title: Date-Palm Residue Database for Saharan Algeria, 2015-2025 (corrected and documented)
description:
Traceable, documented tables on date production and date-palm residues in Saharan Algeria, with the wilaya of El Oued as the focus. Every value carries a status flag: official figure, figure from a secondary compiler, literature coefficient, derived scenario, unverified working estimate or projection.

Contents. National production 2015-2024 (FAOSTAT, cross-checked with the ONS campaign series); Algeria's share of world production; exports 2023-2025 from three compilers; ministry statistics by wilaya for 2017 and 2020; 39 published statements on production, palm stock and area with source links and boundary notes; World Bank governance indicators (2015-2024) for Algeria, Egypt, Tunisia and Qatar; residue coefficients, measured composition and conversion yields from peer-reviewed studies; reported accuracy of date-grading models; three derived residue scenarios for El Oued (33,800 t, 76,450 t and 166,000 t a year) with a one-at-a-time sensitivity analysis; an audit of the authors' original working files; indicators compiled in November 2026 with their verification status; and an inventory of 17 variables still missing, with holder and collection method.

Limits. No residue quantity was measured in the field. The original ten-wilaya working panel fails consistency checks against national statistics and is published only for transparency; it must not be cited as observed data. Figures for 2020 by wilaya refer to boundaries before the 2021 administrative reform.

Reproducibility. The archive contains the raw files, the build and validation scripts (Python, standard library) and the data appendix (Online Resource 1) in Word, PDF and Excel.

Companion data for the book chapter AI-Driven Circular Business Models for Date Palm Waste Valorization in Algeria's El Oued Region, submitted to From Linear to Circular Business Models: AI-Driven Sustainable Growth in Emerging Markets (Palgrave Macmillan).
notes: Data and documentation under CC BY 4.0; scripts under MIT. Status flags and corrections log in docs/.
